escalation.reason: The line follows the reconnaissance-squad members nodding at Gwak Jun’s reaction and reads as their comment on his apparent mistake. The two remarks are untagged, so their individual speakers cannot be distinguished.

findings.explanation: The reconnaissance-squad members react to Gwak Jun’s apparent misunderstanding; the speaker is referring to him, not admitting a mistake of their own.
findings.korean:
그 반응에 정찰조원들이 그럼 그렇지, 하는 얼굴로 고개를 끄덕였다.

“잘못 알고 있었나 보군.”
